title: CBSE Exam Scandal Fuels Mass Student Outrage Against PM Modi
detail: India's CBSE (Central Board of Secondary Education) exam scandal has triggered widespread student protests and public anger directed at Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the ruling BJP government. The controversy — involving allegations of paper leaks and irregularities in high-stakes national examinations — has galvanized youth opposition at a politically sensitive moment, with state elections on the horizon. Critics argue the scandal exposes systemic failures in India's education administration, threatening BJP's standing among young voters.

media.caption: Students protest CBSE exam scandal in India amid calls for accountability
